All in `worker/src/services/ai-dm.ts`.

**Failure handling in `askDM`:**
- Primary call: `@cf/meta/llama-3.3-70b-instruct-fp8-fast` (json_object format). If it throws (or returns a stream), it's caught, logged, and retried with fallback model `@cf/mistral/mistral-7b-instruct-v0.2-lora`.
- If that also throws, `askDM` returns `fallbackNarrative(playerAction)` directly — a hardcoded `AIDMResponse` with generic narrative text, null stat deltas, and canned `suggestedActions`.
- If a model call succeeds, the raw text goes to `parseAIResponse(raw, playerAction)`, which: strips markdown code fences, extracts the first `{...}` block if the text isn't already JSON, then `JSON.parse`s it. On empty/non-string input, no `{...}` match, or a `JSON.parse` throw, it also returns `fallbackNarrative(playerAction)`.

Other helpers (`generateQuest`, `generateBackstory`, `generateLevelUpNarrative`) each wrap their own `ai.run('@cf/meta/llama-3.3-70b-instruct-fp8-fast', …)` call in try/catch and return their own hardcoded canned fallback (e.g. "Blood on the Road" quest, generic backstory/level-up prose) on any error — no retry model or shared `parseAIResponse`/`fallbackNarrative`.
